import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

index = 0
t = int(data[index])
index += 1

results = []

for _ in range(t):
    n = int(data[index])
    m = int(data[index + 1])
    index += 2
    
    friendships = set()
    
    for _ in range(m):
        a = int(data[index]) - 1
        b = int(data[index + 1]) - 1
        index += 2
        friendships.add((a, b))
    
    jury = []
    contestants = []
    
    for i in range(n):
        if all((i, j) not in friendships for j in range(n)):
            jury.append(i + 1)
        elif all((j, i) not in friendships for j in range(n)):
            contestants.append(i + 1)
    
    if len(jury) > 0 and len(contestants) > 0:
        results.append("Yes")
        results.append(f"{len(jury)} {len(contestants)}")
        results.append(" ".join(map(str, jury)))
        results.append(" ".join(map(str, contestants)))
    else:
        results.append("No")

print("\n".join(results))
